pr255.body:
## Description

Adds integrated verification for membership removal, scoped WorkOS staging proof, a disposable SQL restore drill, and release runbooks. The tests verify exact removal, current portal/MCP denial, last-Admin protection, account/other-workspace preservation, self-removal recovery, and independence from export or storage failures. Stacked on [#254](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/pull/254).

The complete successor notice/help bundle is ready for owner review. It is unapproved and unpublished; the earlier notice remains selected at runtime. This PR prepares release and does not mark S2.5-02 Done.

## Review

**T1 Team review**

Architecture: T0: no architecture fact.

The test-gate-policy read path and declared policy change require team review.

**Architecture facts** — candidate `806ccc57`, actual parent `22715457`:

- None. All 49 public-module snapshots are unchanged.

From `.pr-impact.json`: controlled and live tests use existing production interfaces; gate commands add their explicit selections. Runbooks describe existing uncertainty and restore controls. Production source, architecture, schema, dependencies, deployment and runtime notice selection are unchanged. The proposal creates no current client guarantee. The full-stack metric findings retain their recorded reasons.

**Merge blocked:** parent #254 is unmerged, and this head needs independent authorized team/owner approval. No local checker blocker remains.

**Release holds:** actual S2-04 release; exact owner notice approval, effective date and existing-organization/help decisions; approved runtime integration and publication; production storage/$0-capacity checks and a scoped deployed journey. Parent PRs retain their separate approval requirements. Nothing was deployed or published.
